capabilities.name: TaskRuntimeService
capabilities.description: Runtime task lifecycle service for the ``runtime.task_runtime`` cell.

methods.name: create_task_row
methods.doc: Create a task and return the runtime row projection with event evidence.

methods.name: ensure_task_row
methods.doc: Materialize a legacy/orchestration task into the canonical taskboard.

methods.name: update_task_row
methods.doc: Update a task and return the runtime row projection with event evidence.

methods.name: reopen_task_row
methods.doc: Reopen a task and return the runtime row projection with event evidence.

methods.name: list_observable_task_rows
methods.doc: Return task rows for read-only runtime projections.

methods.name: claim_next_execution
methods.doc: Atomically select and claim the next executable task.

methods.name: claim_execution
methods.doc: Claim a task for execution and persist a lease-backed session.

methods.name: complete_execution
methods.doc: Finalize a claimed task as completed.

methods.name: fail_execution
methods.doc: Finalize a claimed task as failed.

methods.name: suspend_execution
methods.doc: Suspend a claimed task so it can be resumed later.

methods.name: suspend_active_executions_for_run
methods.doc: Suspend every active task lease owned by an orchestration run.

capabilities.name: reset_runtime_task_records
capabilities.description: Clear runtime taskboard state through the owning cell service.
